Class AccountBook

java.lang.Object
mybudget.AccountBook
public class AccountBook extends Object
The account book. It keeps the list of transactions and has the functions of the Function Specification.
Version:
0.9 (beta)
Author:

  • Method Details

    • addTransaction

      public boolean addTransaction(Date date, double amount, String type, String category, String description)
      Adds a new transaction. It is only added if the amount is greater than zero and the description is not empty.
      Parameters:
      date - date of the transaction
      amount - amount in KRW
      type - "Income" or "Expense"
      category - category of the transaction
      description - short description
      Returns:
      true if the transaction is added, otherwise false

    • editTransaction

      public boolean editTransaction(int transactionId, Date date, double amount, String type, String category, String description)
      Changes the information of a transaction.
      Parameters:
      transactionId - id of the transaction to change
      date - new date
      amount - new amount
      type - new type
      category - new category
      description - new description
      Returns:
      true if the transaction is updated, otherwise false

    • searchTransactions

      public ArrayList<Transaction> searchTransactions(String month, String category, String type)
      Searches the transactions that match the filters. If the month is empty or a filter is "All", that filter is not used.
      Parameters:
      month - month like "2026-10", or empty
      category - category, or "All"
      type - "Income", "Expense" or "All"
      Returns:
      the transactions that match the filters

    • loadFromFile

      public ArrayList<Transaction> loadFromFile(String path)
      Loads the transactions from a file. If the file does not exist, the list is empty.
      Parameters:
      path - name of the file
      Returns:
      the loaded transactions, or null if the file cannot be read
